method_note: Silence gaps measured on decoded original audio at -35 dB, 150 ms. Every speech interval transcribed locally with Whisper small through sherpa-onnx. Eight-second silence was appended only to ASR analysis windows to avoid sherpa decoder token-budget truncation; original audio was never edited. Phrase start/end are measured waveform intervals, not claimed word-perfect forced alignment. Vendor/English spellings are reference-assisted; uncertain raw recognition is retained for audit.
